note: FNS Section 1063.1 is entirely a QC review methodology section. It describes how QC reviewers should audit earned income in the first and second effective months of a certification using the Comparison I (verify sample month income against error threshold) and Comparison II (correct EW worksheet errors, determine what changes should have been in effect) framework. The concepts of AORD, error thresholds, and the two-comparison structure are QC audit procedures with no caseworker equivalent. The underlying caseworker-side policies (prospective budgeting, income calculation at certification, processing interim changes) are covered in other FNS sections and have corresponding OLG coverage under 'Types of Earned Income', 'Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income in BEACON', and 'Simplified Reporting - Interim Report'. The OLG's 'Quality Assurance Unit' page exists but covers organizational structure, not QC review methodology. This section does not contain SNAP policy requirements that workers need to follow.
